questions.stem: What is the main difference between the atomic models of Dalton and Rutherford?
choices: Dalton’s model includes electrons, while Rutherford’s does not.
Rutherford’s model includes a nucleus, while Dalton’s does not.
Dalton’s model has a positively charged nucleus.
questions.solution: The main difference is that Rutherford’s model includes a nucleus, while Dalton’s does not. This reflects the scientific understanding that Rutherford's model introduced a central, dense core, whereas Dalton's model viewed atoms as indivisible spheres. The other options are incorrect because Dalton's model did not include electrons, and Rutherford's model specifically included a nucleus.

रदरफोर्ड के मॉडल में नाभिक होता है, जबकि डाल्टन के मॉडल में नहीं होता।
डाल्टन के मॉडल में धनात्मक आवेशित नाभिक होता है।
रदरफोर्ड के मॉडल में कोई नाभिक नहीं होता।
hi.solution: मुख्य अंतर यह है कि रदरफोर्ड के मॉडल में नाभिक होता है, जबकि डाल्टन के मॉडल में नहीं होता। यह वैज्ञानिक समझ को प्रतिबिंबित करता है कि रदरफोर्ड के मॉडल ने केंद्रीय, घन नाभिक की अवधारणा प्रस्तुत की, जबकि डाल्टन के मॉडल परमाणुओं को अविभाज्य गोलों के रूप में देखता था। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि डाल्टन के मॉडल में इलेक्ट्रॉन नहीं होते थे और रदरफोर्ड के मॉडल में विशेष रूप से नाभिक होता था।

choices: डाल्टनच्या मॉडेलमध्ये इलेक्ट्रॉन असतात, तर रदरफोर्डच्या मॉडेलमध्ये नाहीत.

mr.solution: मुख्य फरक असा आहे की रदरफोर्डच्या मॉडेलमध्ये न्यूक्लियस असतो, तर डाल्टनच्या मॉडेलमध्ये नाही. हे वैज्ञानिक ज्ञानाच्या अभ्यासाच्या प्रतिबिंबित आहे की रदरफोर्डच्या मॉडेलने केंद्रीय, घन कोरचा परिचय दिला, तर डाल्टनच्या मॉडेलमध्ये परमाणू अविभाज्य गोलाकार विचारले गेले. इतर विकल्प चुकीचे आहेत कारण डाल्टनच्या मॉडेलमध्ये इलेक्ट्रॉन नव्हते आणि रदरफोर्डच्या मॉडेलमध्ये निश्चितपणे न्यूक्लियस असतो.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements correctly describes the structure of an atom according to Rutherford’s atomic model?
choices: An atom is mostly empty space with a dense, positively charged nucleus.
An atom is composed of at least three types of subatomic particles.
An electron has a positive charge and is located inside the nucleus.
An electron has properties of both waves and particles.
questions.solution: According to Rutherford’s atomic model, the atom has a positively charged nucleus at its center and the rest of the atom is mostly empty space. This matches the first option. The second option refers to subatomic particles, which is not directly stated in Rutherford’s model. The third and fourth options describe properties of electrons that are not part of Rutherford’s model.

mr.solution: रदरफोर्डच्या परमाणूच्या मॉडेलनुसार, परमाणूच्या केंद्रावर धनात्मक आवेश असलेला न्यूक्लियस असतो आणि परमाणूच्या बाकीच्या भागात खालीलपैकी एका प्रकारच्या अणुभागांनी बनलेला असतो. हे पहिल्या विधानाशी जुळते. दुसरा विधान अणुभागांच्या बाबतीत आहे, जे रदरफोर्डच्या मॉडेलमध्ये स्पष्टपणे नाही. तिसरा आणि चौथा विधान इलेक्ट्रॉनच्या गुणधर्मांचे वर्णन करतात, जे रदरफोर्डच्या मॉडेलमध्ये नाहीत.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the correct electronic configuration of sodium?
questions.solution: The electronic configuration of sodium is 2, 8, 1 because sodium has 11 electrons. The first shell (K) holds 2 electrons, the second shell (L) holds 8 electrons, and the third shell (M) holds 1 electron. The other options incorrectly distribute the number of electrons in the shells.

questions.stem: What is the main reason why Rutherford's atomic model was considered unstable?
choices: Because electrons lose energy while revolving around the nucleus
Because the nucleus is too large
Because there is no empty space between the nucleus and electrons
Because the positive and negative charges are not balanced
questions.solution: According to the laws of physics, an electrically charged body revolving in a circular orbit loses energy. In Rutherford's model, electrons revolve around the nucleus and would lose energy, making the atom unstable. The other options are incorrect because the nucleus is not too large, empty space exists between the nucleus and electrons, and charges are balanced in Rutherford's model.

choices: क्योंकि नाभिक के चारों ओर घूमते समय इलेक्ट्रॉन ऊर्जा खो देते हैं

mr.stem: रदरफोर्ड अणू मॉडेल अस्थिर मानला गेला का? ह्याचा मुख्य कारण काय आहे?

questions.stem: What is the main function of a moderator in a nuclear reactor?
choices: To reduce the speed of neutrons
To increase the number of neutrons

questions.stem: Why is an atom electrically neutral?
choices: Because the number of protons equals the number of electrons
Because the number of protons equals the number of neutrons
questions.solution: The correct answer is because the number of protons equals the number of electrons. Protons have a positive charge and electrons have a negative charge, so when their numbers are equal, the charges cancel out, making the atom electrically neutral. The other options are incorrect because having no charge is not a scientific explanation, protons and neutrons have different charges, and the nucleus itself is positively charged.

questions.stem: In Rutherford's atomic model, where is the mass of the atom mainly concentrated?
choices: In the empty space between the nucleus and electrons
In the orbit of the electrons
questions.solution: In Rutherford's atomic model, the mass of the atom is primarily found in the nucleus because it contains protons and neutrons, which are much heavier than electrons. The orbit of the electrons also does not contain significant mass.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about the nucleus in Rutherford’s atomic model?

The option stating it is negatively charged is also incorrect because protons, not electrons, are the primary charge carriers in the nucleus.
